in_marathi.name: Hrithvik
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Vishnu's Leap
in_marathi.long_meaning: Hrithvik हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit root 'hrith' meaning 'that which is stable' and 'vik' meaning 'leap' or 'jump'. This name symbolizes the divine leap of Lord Vishnu to preserve the universe from destruction.

This name symbolizes the divine leap of Lord Vishnu to preserve the universe from destruction.
